items.one: The retraining program to become an <important>IT Specialist for App Development</important> consists of theoretical and practical learning phases as well as the final exam.

items.three: As a central part of the program, I will complete a company internship where I can apply my theoretical knowledge in daily work and gain valuable practical experience.

items.one: Completed the demanding full-stack program at Germany's leading TÜV-certified academy for web development. Successfully built more than 12 projects, both individually and as part of a team.

About.landing_about_title: Full-Stack Developer and a little bit of
About.landing_about_text_1: I'm Alessandro, a full-stack developer passionate about creating dynamic web experiences. From frontend to backend, I thrive on solving complex problems with clean, efficient code. My expertise spans Angular, React, and Next.js, and I'm always ready to learn more.
About.landing_about_text_2: When I'm not immersed in work, I'm exploring new ideas or new mountains and staying curious. Life is about balance, and I love embracing every part of it, especially in a snowpark.
About.landing_about_text_3: I believe small daily progress leads to big results.
About.about_page_text_1: I'm Alessandro, a full-stack developer passionate about creating dynamic web experiences. From frontend to backend, I solve complex problems with clean, efficient code. My expertise spans Python, Angular, Typescript and React, and I'm always motivated to learn more.
About.about_page_text_2: When I'm not immersed in work, I explore new mountains, cruising through fresh powder or doing 360s in a snowpark.
About.about_page_text_3: I believe in waking up each day eager to make a difference!
